purpose: Explain commands and their effects.
arguments_and_options: Optional command path; --help is also available on every command.
expected_behavior: Print usage; selectors; defaults; examples; and whether the operation changes runtime state.
design_notes: The executable name and all syntax in this table are recommendations rather than implemented commands.

purpose: Report the installed application version.
arguments_and_options: --version; optionally --output json.
expected_behavior: Print application version and the bundled GreenMail version without starting listeners.
design_notes: Pin supported JVM and GreenMail versions when packaging is selected.

purpose: Run an IMAP server in the foreground.
arguments_and_options: --fixtures-root PATH; --fixture NAME repeatable or --all mutually exclusive; --imap-bind ADDRESS; --imap-port PORT; --instance NAME; --log-level LEVEL.
expected_behavior: Validate the startup selection; load its accounts; report readiness only when initialization completes; serve until stop or a termination signal. With no fixture selection start an empty environment.
design_notes: Recommend ./fixtures as the host fixture-root default; local as the instance default; loopback and port 3143 as host listener defaults. Confirm these defaults and choose the local control mechanism.

purpose: Start with all scenarios from a fixture root.
arguments_and_options: --fixtures-root PATH; --all; other start options. Reject --all combined with --fixture.
expected_behavior: Preflight all discovered scenarios and cross-scenario identities before readiness; fail startup if initialization cannot complete.
design_notes: Use an explicit --all because a fixture root may contain conflicting alternative scenarios.

purpose: Stop a selected running instance gracefully.
arguments_and_options: --instance NAME; --timeout DURATION; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Request shutdown; wait until listeners and management resources are released; return failure for an unavailable instance or a shutdown timeout.
design_notes: Define the default shutdown timeout and how the CLI verifies complete termination. Ctrl-C and container termination signals use the same shutdown behavior.

purpose: Inspect runtime readiness and effective configuration.
arguments_and_options: --instance NAME; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Report readiness; effective non-secret configuration; listener address and port; fixture root; and loaded account count. Exit unsuccessfully if unavailable or not ready.
design_notes: Use this capability for container health checks; determine readiness during serialized management operations.

purpose: Display IMAP connection details.
arguments_and_options: --instance NAME; optional --account LOGIN; --show-passwords; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Report effective IMAP endpoint; transport mode; and selected or all login identities. Omit passwords unless explicitly requested.
design_notes: Bind addresses such as 0.0.0.0 are not client destinations; document host and container addresses and externally mapped ports separately.

purpose: Discover available scenarios and account selectors without contacting the server.
arguments_and_options: --fixtures-root PATH; optional --fixture NAME repeatable; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: List scenarios; their source account selectors; and resolved login identities in stable order; distinguish discovery from full payload validation.
design_notes: Recommend source selectors such as normal/alice and runtime selectors such as alice@example.test; identity mapping follows the eventual metadata convention.

purpose: Validate one or more scenarios offline.
arguments_and_options: --fixtures-root PATH; --fixture NAME repeatable or --all mutually exclusive; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Validate selected structure; metadata; messages; and duplicate identities across the combined selection; report deterministic path-specific errors and warnings without mutation.
design_notes: Require an explicit selection; define whether malformed payloads warn or fail and how unknown metadata fields are handled.

purpose: Validate every scenario under a fixture root.
arguments_and_options: --fixtures-root PATH; --all; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Validate each scenario independently and report cross-scenario identity reuse as a compatibility warning; alternative scenarios may intentionally share accounts.
design_notes: Unlike a combined load selection this command audits a catalog; explain that --all loading still rejects identity collisions.

purpose: Validate one source account independently.
arguments_and_options: --fixtures-root PATH; --account SOURCE_SELECTOR repeatable; --output text|json. Account selection is mutually exclusive with --fixture and --all.
expected_behavior: Validate selected accounts with applicable parent metadata; reject path traversal; do not require unrelated accounts to load.
design_notes: Resolve source selectors inside the explicit fixture root and define inheritance before fixing metadata filenames.

purpose: Load one or multiple complete scenarios into a running instance.
arguments_and_options: --instance NAME; --fixture NAME repeatable; optional --replace; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Resolve sources using the running instance's fixture root; preflight the combined selection; load accounts and register reset baselines; preserve unrelated loaded accounts.
design_notes: Default to rejecting loaded-account conflicts. --replace explicitly recreates conflicting selected accounts; report runtime failure boundaries without promising batch rollback.

purpose: Load all scenarios from the running instance's configured fixture root.
arguments_and_options: --instance NAME; --all; optional --replace; --output text|json. Reject --all combined with --fixture.
expected_behavior: Preflight all selected accounts and reject duplicate identities even with --replace; retain unrelated loaded accounts; report the outcome for each affected account.
design_notes: --replace resolves collisions with runtime accounts only; it cannot select between colliding source scenarios.

purpose: Load or recreate selected accounts without loading their full scenarios.
arguments_and_options: One or more source account selectors; --instance NAME; optional --replace; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Apply parent metadata; validate selected account sources; import messages and folders; and register baselines. An empty fixture account creates an empty managed account.
design_notes: Recommend representing empty account creation with an empty fixture account rather than a separate credentials-bearing create command.

purpose: Explicitly adopt an edited source fixture or recreate a loaded account.
arguments_and_options: Source selectors; --replace; --instance NAME; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Validate the current source and replace selected runtime accounts and registered baselines; remove session changes in those accounts; report whether client reconnection is required.
design_notes: Reset uses the registered baseline; explicit replacement adopts source edits. Decide snapshot versus change-detection behavior and recovery if import fails.

purpose: List accounts currently loaded in the selected instance.
arguments_and_options: --instance NAME; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Report login identities; source selectors; and current folder/message counts in stable order without exposing passwords.
design_notes: Counts describe current runtime contents; source discovery uses fixtures list.

purpose: Remove selected runtime accounts and their mailboxes.
arguments_and_options: One or more exact login identities; --instance NAME; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Remove selected accounts and their registered baselines; invalidate relevant sessions as supported; retain all fixture source files and unrelated accounts.
design_notes: Recommend failure for missing accounts and no confirmation prompt; preflight all identities. Deletion excludes the account from future reset --all; explicit load recreates it.

purpose: Restore selected loaded accounts to registered initial state.
arguments_and_options: One or more exact login identities; --instance NAME; --output text|json. Reject identity arguments combined with --all.
expected_behavior: Restore registered accounts; folders; messages; and supported flags/dates; remove session-created state within the selected accounts; preserve unrelated accounts.
design_notes: Fail for missing accounts; report reconnection requirements. Stable IMAP UIDs are not promised; source changes must not silently alter the baseline.

purpose: Reset the entire currently registered environment.
arguments_and_options: --all; --instance NAME; --output text|json.
expected_behavior: Reset every currently registered account to its baseline and remove session-created mailbox state; succeed with a zero-account result for an empty environment.
design_notes: Recommend currently registered accounts as the reset boundary; do not resurrect accounts explicitly deleted or reload every fixture on disk.

purpose: Run the application with mounted fixtures and a published IMAP port.
arguments_and_options: Read-only bind mount at /fixtures; host port 3143 to container port 3143; image command start; container IMAP bind 0.0.0.0; loopback host publishing.
example: docker run --rm --name astraeawave -p 127.0.0.1:3143:3143 -v "$PWD/fixtures:/fixtures:ro" astraeawave:local start --fixtures-root /fixtures --fixture normal --imap-bind 0.0.0.0 --imap-port 3143
expected_behavior: Run in the foreground with an immutable source mount; readiness means loaded mail is available at 127.0.0.1:3143 to host clients.
design_notes: Illustrative image tag; recommend an image ENTRYPOINT of astraeawave. Management remains accessible through exec without publishing a control port.

purpose: Run the same fixture-driven image with Podman.
arguments_and_options: Use the same mount; listener; and port conventions as the Docker example.
example: podman run --rm --name astraeawave -p 127.0.0.1:3143:3143 -v "$PWD/fixtures:/fixtures:ro" astraeawave:local start --fixtures-root /fixtures --fixture normal --imap-bind 0.0.0.0 --imap-port 3143
expected_behavior: Host clients connect after readiness; fixture data remains unchanged; no SMTP or POP3 ports are published.
design_notes: Confirm non-root permissions and host-platform mount requirements when the image is implemented.

purpose: Use the application CLI to manage an existing container.
arguments_and_options: Container name followed by the application executable and any runtime management command.
example: docker exec astraeawave astraeawave accounts reset --all
expected_behavior: Execute reset against the container's running default instance; the same pattern supports status; connection; load; list; delete; and stop.
design_notes: Substitute podman for docker; a custom --instance must match the name used at startup. Offline fixture validation can also run through exec.

purpose: Terminate the foreground server through container lifecycle controls.
arguments_and_options: Container name; optional engine shutdown timeout.
expected_behavior: Deliver a termination signal to the server process and allow graceful shutdown; fixture sources remain unchanged.
design_notes: Image entrypoint must pass signals to the application; confirm timeout coordination and health checks during packaging.
